name: e-calisthenics
about: A made-up intermediate calisthenics trainee: 3 days x 60 min at home with a pull-up bar and rings, skills first.

expected.why: 3 days x 30-60 min for an intermediate is undulating full body (heavy, moderate, volume days). The skill modifier opens every session with a skill block, a different skill each day; bodyweight lifts progress by ladder. Every fixture also asserts: all checks pass (volume bands, concurrent placement, schema, equipment, Ledger, time, constant main lifts), deloads every 4th week, a calibration week first, tests at each phase end, and identical output on a second run.
